notes.title: ELEMENTAL SOUL Demo - 0.3.0 is now Live!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643803/f55d6688f2b943ef22b7f717224ffddcfac286ab.png"][/img][/p][p][b]ELEMENTAL SOUL Demo – 0.3.0 has been updated![/b][/p][p][/p][p]In this demo version, you can play up to [b]Chapter 3[/b], and through a short storyline you can now experience the true roguelite progression system.[/p][p][/p][p]The demo was originally released about a week ago, but we have been working on various improvements since then![/p][p]Compared to the initial demo release, the following changes have been made:[/p][list][*][p]Updated start screen[/p][/*][*][p]Dialogue and choice window UI adjusted to be less disruptive during gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced UI explanations[/p][/*][*][p]Collect items with the W key[/p][/*][*][p]Radar now displays the map, improving visibility[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dash damage[/p][/*][*][p]Added 3 new weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Updated UI and adjusted resolution[/p][/*][*][p]Item effects can now be previewed before acquisition[/p][/*][*][p]Additional story after the dungeon[/p][/*][*][p]Additional story after the mountain[/p][/*][*][p]Added new village NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Added weapon swap feature[/p][/*][*][p]Added new story content and fixed story bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Added story skip feature[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented roguelite stat progression system[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The demo version will continue to feature 3 playable chapters, but it will also receive continuous updates![/p][p]Upcoming updates: Gameplay improvements, Art Improvement, new items, balance adjustments, quality-of-life enhancements, and more.[/p]
